name: Firebase
description: Firebase is Google's platform of services for building and running apps, covering the complete app development lifecycle with tools for databases, authentication, hosting, and serverless functions.
best_for: Development teams building Apple, Android, Web, Flutter, Unity, or C++ apps who want a managed backend without running their own servers; used by teams at NPR, Duolingo, and Venmo.

tiers.name: Spark
tiers.notes: No-cost plan with generous fixed usage quotas across most products; no payment method required.

tiers.name: Blaze
tiers.notes: Pay-as-you-go: no-cost Spark quotas still apply daily, then billing follows the underlying Google Cloud infrastructure's own usage-based rates -- not a flat monthly fee, so total cost depends on real usage and needs Google's own pricing calculator to estimate.

cons: Beyond the free Spark plan, cost is usage-based against Google Cloud infrastructure rates, not a flat per-seat or per-project fee -- predicting a monthly bill requires Google's own pricing calculator rather than a plan comparison table.
No-cost usage quotas apply at the project level, not per app, so multiple apps in one project share the same free allowance.
Deep platform lock-in to Google's own infrastructure and tooling, unlike a self-hostable alternative such as Supabase.
features: Firestore NoSQL database for storing and syncing application data
Authentication with secure user login and identity management
Cloud Functions for running serverless backend code
App Hosting for deploying and managing web applications
Crashlytics for real-time crash monitoring and diagnosis
Remote Config for updating app behavior without a release
Google Analytics integration for user behavior tracking

alternatives.name: Supabase
alternatives.description: An open source Firebase alternative providing a Postgres-backed backend with auth, storage, and edge functions.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want a self-hostable backend built on a real SQL database.

alternatives.name: Render
alternatives.description: A cloud platform for deploying web services, background workers, cron jobs, static sites, and databases.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want managed cloud infrastructure for custom backends.
